Noah (AE): Olivia says their POC UI throws JSON.parse errors for some streamed messages — only on longer outputs.
Olivia (Client): repro steps: open SSE to /poc/stream, after several events one event causes `Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token \u0000 in JSON at position 0`. No 5xx from server.
Karen (SE): can you capture the raw bytes: `curl -N -s https://host/poc/stream > out.bin` then `xxd -g1 out.bin | sed -n '1,120p'` and paste the region around the failure?
Olivia (Client): hexdump snippet: `... 7d 0a 0a 64 61 74 61 3a 20 7b 22id":"xyz"7d 00 0a 0a` — there's 00 after `}`.
Theo (Oncall): 0x00 in the stream will break JS parsers. Likely causes: proxy buffer padding (nginx) or CDN normalization, or backend writing fixed-size buffered blocks. Are you fronted by a reverse proxy/CDN?
Olivia (Client): yes nginx + Cloudflare.
Marta (Eng): on Redwood we've hit this class: proxies sometimes re-chunk and pad leftover buffer space with NULs. For SSE you must ensure chunked transfer and disable proxy buffering for that route.
Karen (SE): nginx quick checklist for SSE location: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_request_buffering off; gzip off; proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on; proxy_set_header Connection ''; proxy_read_timeout 3600; sendfile off;` Also make sure upstream responses do not set Content-Length.
Olivia (Client): applied `proxy_buffering off` and redeployed. curl hexdump now shows no 00 bytes. Browser still saw one stray error earlier but it's much rarer.
Marta (Eng): client-side hardening recommended: accumulate until the SSE blank-line delimiter is observed before parsing. Example pattern: `let buf=''; res.on('data',c=>{buf+=c; while(buf.indexOf('\n\n')>-1){const evt=buf.slice(0,buf.indexOf('\n\n'));buf=buf.slice(buf.indexOf('\n\n')+2);const payload=evt.split('\n').filter(l=>l.startsWith('data:')).map(l=>l.replace(/^data:\s*/,'')).join('\n');const clean=payload.replace(/\u0000/g,''); try{JSON.parse(clean)}catch(e){console.warn('sse parse',e,payload)} }})`
deploy-bot: Deploy `poc/sse-proxy-fix` to staging succeeded (build #909).
Ivy (Presales): can we flip a tenant runtime flag to emit stricter SSE boundaries for this POC?
Marta (Eng): yes we can enable `sse_strict=true` for the tenant; low risk and will log padding occurrences. Ivy please document in the POC notes.
Olivia (Client): after nginx change + client buffering it's stable for 36 hours. thanks all.
Noah (AE): action items: 1) Marta/Theo to add nginx+Cloudflare SSE guidance to POC docs, 2) Karen/Ivy to note the runtime flag toggle and client workaround in the POC wrap-up. Please add links when done.
Theo (Oncall): I'll also scan edge proxies for similar `00` padding and open tickets if found.
Noah (AE): nice swoop — closing for now :tada:
